usedFor: Signwell holds signature documents and Sangam CRM tracks sales, so “Document Completed” can open one with “Create Opportunity”.

bestTemplate.name: “Document Completed” in Signwell, then “Create Opportunity” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A fully signed document is a won step, and the action sets custom fields and a next follow-up date.

watchOut: “Document Viewed” fires when a signer first opens a document, so it suits “Create or Update Lead”, not an opportunity.
